# Municipal Ordinance No. 04, Series of 1990

**Requiring submission of worker names to police by fishing businesses**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance mandates all owners of fishing boats, fishponds, and fry gatherers in [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to submit a list of their workers to the local police station. This list must be submitted every January 1st and before hiring any new worker. Workers must obtain clearance from the police to ensure they have no criminal record.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1:** Requires owners of fishing boats, fishponds, and fry gatherers to submit a list of their workers' names to the police station every January 1st and before hiring. Workers must obtain police clearance.
2.  **Section 2:** Penalties for violations include imprisonment of up to ten (10) days and/or a fine of fifty pesos (₱50.00). Subsequent violations will result in doubled penalties.
3.  **Section 3:** Any conflicting ordinances or parts thereof are repealed.
4.  **Section 4:** This ordinance takes effect forty (40) days after its approval.
5.  **Section 5:** Approved on November 5, 1990 in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
